band_stability.knife_edge_note: The frozen Q1 and Q3 knots sit exactly on the band cut points (111.5/446 = 0.25 and 334.5/446 = 0.75), so the prespecified quartile grid measures stability at the least stable possible points. Read it together with the population-wide concordance and the distance-to-cut strata.
band_stability.prespecified_criterion: >= 90% band concordance at the frozen quartile knots

beta.note: beta < 0 in a replicate means the deployed direction holds: faster PSA elimination -> higher percentile -> lower relative hazard.

b6_band_stability.caveat: The bootstrap percentile interval at a fixed k_day quantifies reference-distribution resampling uncertainty. It is not a new-patient predictive interval.
b6_band_stability.prespecified_criterion: >= 90% band concordance at the frozen quartile knots
b6_band_stability.verdict: FAILED AS PRESPECIFIED. Quartile-knot concordance 0.6662 vs the >= 0.90 requirement. The failure is structural, not sampling noise: the frozen Q1 and Q3 knots sit exactly on the 0.25 and 0.75 cut points, so the prespecified grid measures the least stable points in the distribution. Population-wide concordance across all 446 knots is 0.9669. No threshold was moved and relative_prognostic_band was not removed; the finding is disclosed in the emitted limitations and the continuous reference_percentile is recommended near a cut.

The prespecified band stability gate FAILED: quartile-knot concordance 0.6662 against a required 0.90 in the B6 joint bootstrap (B=2000). The same bootstrap gave concordance 0.9456 on the full knot grid and 96.7% population-wide, but only 49-51% for values sitting exactly on the 0.25 / 0.75 cut points; the prespecified evaluation is the quartile-knot one, and the higher figures do not replace it. relative_prognostic_band is therefore null on every code path and no category may be inferred from any emitted continuous field.

coefficient_conditional_relative_hazard_interval propagates Cox coefficient uncertainty only. It does not include uncertainty in the patient's PSA-rate fit, reference CDF or assay measurements, and it is not a patient-level confidence interval. Its width is proportional to |z_rank|, so it approaches zero at the reference median.

percentile_uncertainty_interval, k_day_uncertainty_interval and multiplier_uncertainty_interval propagate resampling of this patient's own analysis days only, holding the frozen coefficient and reference distribution fixed. Neither interval emitted by this service is a joint interval over all three uncertainty components.

In the frozen reference cohort the individual-rate component was the widest of the three components for 292 of 412 patients with estimable uncertainty, and the median joint interval was about twice the width of the coefficient-only interval.

fit_precision_status is an output-quality annotation, not a cohort filter. The n=446 frozen reference population is unchanged and was not filtered on fit precision. In that population only 12.6% of patients were RELIABLE.

An unstable resampled decline sign fails closed with reason UNSTABLE_DECLINE_SIGN. Fewer than four distinct analysis days yields fit_precision_status INSUFFICIENT_FOR_UNCERTAINTY, in which case the point index is still served and every uncertainty field is null.
The reference distribution is a single external trial (VENICE); portability of a within-trial rank transform to other populations is untested.

production_defects_found_by_tests.fix: Module-level _UNSET sentinel; the guard now resolves PROSTATE_PSA_COX_BETA at call time and validates the value the arithmetic will actually use.
production_defects_found_by_tests.symptom: _assert_negative_beta(beta: float = PROSTATE_PSA_COX_BETA) bound the coefficient as a DEFINITION-TIME default, so the per-call guard validated the import-time value while the transform resolves the module global at call time. A runtime mutation of the global could have flipped the prognostic direction silently.

production_defects_found_by_tests.carve_out_rationale: treatment_priority is simultaneously a mandated fail-closed key name and a forbidden claim phrase. The contract self-declares its refused key names as string values, so without the exemption no shipped payload could serialize. Any surrounding text is a claim and is still caught; _normalize_key strips spaces, so the spaced prose form 'treatment priority' can never be exempted.
production_defects_found_by_tests.fix: Two-pass scan. Pass 1 is the original literal blob. Pass 2 walks the payload with a dedicated recursive walker that collapses '_' and '-' runs to spaces and lowercases, then re-scans. Exactly one carve-out: an EXACT whole-string self-reference to a mandated fail-closed key name, in key position or whole-string value position, is exempt.

purpose: Machine-readable implementation receipt for the externally OS-associated PSA RELATIVE PROGNOSTIC INDEX. No absolute-risk calibration and no treatment-predictive field is created or activated by this work.

reference_artifact.cdf_convention: Frozen empirical midrank plotting position F(k) = (L + E/2)/n with L = #{k_i < k} and E = #{k_i == k}. For a distinct value at 1-indexed rank r this equals (r - 0.5)/n, which is exactly the transformation the locked Cox model was fitted on. The naive i/n ECDF is deliberately NOT used: it would return 1.0 at the reference maximum and be inconsistent with the fitted coefficient.
reference_artifact.lower_extrapolation_policy: k below the lowest knot returns the lowest knot's plotting position 0.5/n. Never 0.
reference_artifact.upper_extrapolation_policy: k above the highest knot returns the highest knot's plotting position (n - 0.5)/n. Never 1.
